WOODWORK — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: WOODWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Emergency Management, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Emergency Management.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Emergency Management.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Emergency Management.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Emergency Management.

2. When learning Design in Woodwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Design in Woodwork.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Design in Woodwork.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Design in Woodwork.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Design in Woodwork.

3. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. Monitor
   C. Speaker
   D. CPU

4. When learning Framed Wooden Doors and Windows, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Framed Wooden Doors and Windows.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Framed Wooden Doors and Windows.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Framed Wooden Doors and Windows.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Framed Wooden Doors and Windows.

5. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Remove all guards

6. When learning Upholstery, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Upholstery.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Upholstery.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Upholstery.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Upholstery.

7. When learning Blending wood with other materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Blending wood with other materials.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Blending wood with other materials.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Blending wood with other materials.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Blending wood with other materials.

8. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. International Cricket Team

9. When learning Occupational Information, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Occupational Information.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Occupational Information.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Occupational Information.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Occupational Information.

10. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

11. When learning Project Activity, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Project Activity.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project Activity.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project Activity.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project Activity.

12. When learning Furniture Making, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Furniture Making.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Furniture Making.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Furniture Making.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Furniture Making.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Furniture Making and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Framed Wooden Doors and Windows and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Fittings and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Upholstery and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Emergency Management.

2. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Design in Woodwork.

3. D — CPU

4. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Framed Wooden Doors and Windows.

5. B — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

6. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Upholstery.

7. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Blending wood with other materials.

8. C — Information and Communication Technology

9. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Occupational Information.

10. D — Never touch live wires with wet hands

11. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project Activity.

12. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Furniture Making.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Furniture Making; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Framed Wooden Doors and Windows; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Fittings; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Upholstery; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
